jobs.title: General Application
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ataraxis AI

Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients.

Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis™ Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research.

Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis™ Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide.

At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine.

Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity).

We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential.

General Application

Please note that this general application is not monitored on a daily basis and you will hear from us only if there is a relevant opening that you might be a fit for, or if you have a very interesting background. We are always looking for talented people across all domain who want to contribute to our mission.

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for people at any stage of their career who:

  1. Want to build a generational company with us, and want their work at Ataraxis to become a career-defining (or even life-defining) event.

  2. Are humble yet ambitious and confident. There is no work that's below you.

  3. Are self-motivated and relentless. You will have a lot of independence and freedom to act, and you are expected to capitalize on it.

  4. Have elite standards and consistently produce work at a level that sets the bar for others.

  • Excellent skills in Python and PyTorch.

  • Experience in deep learning and computational pathology. Experience in self-supervised learning, survival analysis, multi-modal learning, domain adaptation, causal inference or model interpretability is a bonus.

About Ataraxis AI

Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients.

Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis™ Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research.

Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis™ Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide.

At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine.

Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity).

We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential.

Responsibilities

You will build Ataraxis's pharma partnership business from the ground up. Ataraxis has developed prognostic and predictive AI models validated in breast cancer, with potential applications across drug development, such as companion diagnostics, biomarker discovery, patient stratification, and trial rescue. This role owns pharma as a revenue stream alongside our diagnostics business. In that process, you will:

  • Identify target companies, map the decision unit inside each, run outreach, and lead negotiations to signature.

  • Construct novel applications of our technology against each company's development pipeline and translate them for scientific, clinical, and business audiences.

  • Build and maintain relationships with the people inside pharma who sponsor and fund partnerships.

  • Bring pharma priorities and unmet needs back to our research and product teams.

  • Work with research, clinical, product, and legal to scope what we commit to, structure the terms, and get agreements signed.

  • Work directly with the CEO on pipeline, forecast, and deal strategy.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in pharma and/or diagnostics business development, from inside pharma or from a diagnostics or technology company selling into pharma.

  • Preferred: MD, PhD, PharmD, NP, or a Master’s degree in cancer biology, molecular biology, cell biology, biomedical sciences, pharmacology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related life sciences field.

  • Documented track record of leading or co-leading pharma deals in companion diagnostics, biomarkers, patient stratification, or similar. If you did not formally lead one, we want evidence you were pivotal in getting it done.

  • Built a pharma partnership pipeline from scratch, or decided from the pharma side which partnerships got funded.

  • Fluency in how pharma makes partnership decisions: who decides, where the budget sits within a business unit, and how deals actually get pushed through.

  • Relationships across large and mid-cap oncology pharma that you can activate now.

  • Comfortable doing deep on technical material, with a history of finding non-obvious applications for it.

  • Bias for action.
